# Nature

> Nature is the world’s leading multidisciplinary science journal, publishing peer-reviewed research, news, commentary and analysis across the sciences.

Nature.com is the home of the flagship Nature journal and the wider Nature Portfolio. It provides access to current and archived issues, research articles, news reporting, opinion, careers content, podcasts, newsletters and author services for researchers, clinicians, policy readers and institutions.

## Nature Journal

- [Nature home](https://www.nature.com/nature/): Main landing page for the flagship journal, featuring latest research, news and issue highlights.
- [Current issue](https://www.nature.com/nature/current-issue): Browse the latest issue of Nature, including research, editorial and commentary content.
- [Archive](https://www.nature.com/nature/archive): Access past volumes and issues of Nature by year and volume.
- [Research articles](https://www.nature.com/nature/research-articles): Peer-reviewed primary research published in Nature.
- [News & Views](https://www.nature.com/nature/news-and-views): Expert commentary explaining the significance of newly published research.
- [Reviews & Analysis](https://www.nature.com/nature/reviews-and-analysis): In-depth review articles and analytical pieces on major scientific topics.
- [Letters](https://www.nature.com/nature/research-articles?type=letter): Short-format primary research papers published in Nature.
- [Subjects](https://www.nature.com/subjects): Browse Nature content by scientific subject area.

## News, Comment & Journalism

- [News](https://www.nature.com/news): Science journalism covering discoveries, policy, funding, careers and research culture.
- [News articles](https://www.nature.com/news/articles): Reported news stories from across science and academia.
- [Features](https://www.nature.com/news/features): Long-form feature reporting on scientific developments and communities.
- [Opinion](https://www.nature.com/news/opinion): Commentaries and perspectives on science policy, ethics and research practice.
- [Explainers](https://www.nature.com/news/explainers): Background articles clarifying scientific concepts, methods and debates.
- [Career Feature](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers): Careers reporting, advice and job-related editorial for researchers.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nature.com/nature/articles?type=nature-podcast): Nature Podcast and audio coverage of research and news.

## Research by Subject

- [Biological sciences](https://www.nature.com/subjects/biological-sciences): Research and commentary across molecular, cellular and organismal biology.
- [Physical sciences](https://www.nature.com/subjects/physical-sciences): Content spanning physics, chemistry, materials science and related fields.
- [Earth & environmental sciences](https://www.nature.com/subjects/earth-and-environmental-sciences): Research on climate, geoscience, ecology and environmental change.
- [Health sciences](https://www.nature.com/subjects/health-sciences): Biomedical and clinical research, public health and translational medicine.
- [Mathematics & computing](https://www.nature.com/subjects/mathematics-and-computing): Articles on computation, AI, information science and mathematical methods.
- [Neuroscience](https://www.nature.com/subjects/neuroscience): Research and news on the brain, cognition and neural systems.
- [Genetics](https://www.nature.com/subjects/genetics): Genetics, genomics and heredity-related research and analysis.
- [Cancer](https://www.nature.com/subjects/cancer): Oncology research, mechanisms, therapies and translational advances.

## Journals & Publications

- [Nature Portfolio journals A–Z](https://www.nature.com/siteindex): Directory of Nature-branded journals, magazines and subject-specific publications.
- [Nature Reviews journals](https://www.nature.com/naturereviews): Hub for the Nature Reviews family of journals.
- [Nature Communications](https://www.nature.com/ncomms/): Multidisciplinary open-access journal publishing high-quality research across the sciences.
- [Scientific Reports](https://www.nature.com/srep/): Open-access journal for original research from all areas of natural and clinical sciences.
- [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/nm/): Journal covering biomedical research with clinical and translational relevance.
- [Nature Biotechnology](https://www.nature.com/nbt/): Research and analysis on biotechnology, bioengineering and applied life sciences.
- [Nature Physics](https://www.nature.com/nphys/): Journal publishing significant advances across experimental and theoretical physics.
- [Nature Climate Change](https://www.nature.com/nclimate/): Research and commentary on climate science, impacts and policy.

## Search, Browse & Discovery

- [Search](https://www.nature.com/search): Search across articles, journals, news and other Nature content.
- [Advanced search](https://www.nature.com/search/advanced): Refine searches by keyword, author, journal, date and content type.
- [Latest research and reviews](https://www.nature.com/latest-research): Recently published research and review content across Nature Portfolio.
- [Latest news](https://www.nature.com/latest-news): Recently published science news and journalism from Nature.
- [Collections](https://www.nature.com/collections): Curated article collections organized around themes, topics and events.
- [Subjects index](https://www.nature.com/subjects): Topic index for navigating content by discipline and specialty.

## Authors & Submission

- [For authors](https://www.nature.com/nature/for-authors): Submission policies, editorial criteria and manuscript preparation guidance for Nature.
- [Submit manuscript](https://mts-nature.nature.com/cgi-bin/main.plex): Manuscript submission system for Nature journals.
- [Editorial policies](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies): Policies covering peer review, ethics, authorship and data availability.
- [Reporting standards](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/reporting-standards): Standards and checklists for transparent reporting of research methods and results.
- [Publishing policies](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies#publishing-policies): Policy guidance on corrections, retractions, ethics and publication practice.
- [Open access](https://www.nature.com/openaccess): Information on open-access publishing options across Nature Portfolio.
- [Author services](https://authorservices.springernature.com/): Editing, submission support and publication services for authors.

## Peer Review, Ethics & Research Integrity

- [Peer review at Nature Portfolio](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/peer-review): Overview of peer-review models, processes and editorial assessment.
- [Research data policies](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/reporting-standards#availability-of-data-materials-code-and-protocols): Requirements for data, code and materials availability statements.
- [Competing interests policy](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/competing-interests): Disclosure requirements for authors, reviewers and editors.
- [Image integrity and standards](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/image-integrity): Guidance on acceptable image processing and figure presentation.
- [Appeals and complaints](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/appeals-and-complaints): Procedures for manuscript appeals and editorial complaints.
- [Research ethics](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/editorial-policies/research-ethics): Policies on human participants, animals, consent and ethical oversight.

## Careers, Jobs & Community

- [Nature Careers](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers): Career advice, features and resources for scientists at all stages.
- [Jobs](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers/jobs): Academic, industry and research job listings from around the world.
- [Career articles](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers/articles): Reported articles and advice on scientific careers and workplaces.
- [Postdoc resources](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers/postdocs): Career guidance and opportunities relevant to postdoctoral researchers.
- [Employer services](https://www.nature.com/naturecareers/employer): Recruitment and employer branding services for institutions and companies.
- [Community voices](https://www.nature.com/immersive/d41586-023-03919-1/index.html): Perspectives and experiences from researchers across the scientific community.

## Multimedia, Briefings & Alerts

- [Nature Briefing](https://www.nature.com/briefing): Daily and weekly email newsletters summarizing important science news and papers.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nature.com/nature/articles?type=nature-podcast): Audio interviews and discussions on new research and science news.
- [Videos](https://www.nature.com/video): Video explainers, interviews and research visualizations.
- [Webcasts](https://www.nature.com/webcasts): Recorded and live online events on research topics and publishing.
- [Newsletters](https://www.nature.com/newsletters): Sign up for topic-specific and editorial email newsletters.
- [RSS feeds](https://www.nature.com/nature.rss): Syndicated feed for Nature journal content updates.

## Access, Subscriptions & Account Help

- [Subscribe to Nature](https://www.nature.com/nature/subscribe): Personal and institutional subscription options for the flagship journal.
- [Nature+](https://www.nature.com/natureplus): Membership and access offering for readers of Nature journalism and analysis.
- [Access options](https://www.nature.com/nature/subscribe?error=cookies_not_supported&code=2000): Subscription and access pathways for readers and institutions.
- [Account sign in](https://idp.nature.com/authorize/sign_in): Sign in to a Nature account for subscriptions, saved content and alerts.
- [Help](https://support.nature.com/): Customer support for access, subscriptions, accounts and permissions.
- [Rights and permissions](https://www.nature.com/reprints-and-permissions): Request reuse permissions, reprints and licensing information.
